title: Dear,
body:
Many summers, falls, winters, and springs
have passed since our last morning drive to
the bus stop. The growing pains in my shins
have left me, my favorite childhood jackets
have long been retired, and my army of
stuffed animals has disbanded. Tears shed
have since transpired into the clouds and
rained down an ocean away. I hope one day
they will return to me through the water I sip
in the company of my fondest or in the mist
that creeps through my window when I drive
in solitude through the mountains at dusk.

Until that day comes, I'll keep delivering my
sunflower satellites into the deep blue to
find you in hopes that they'll convey the
words I never had the chance to leave you
with.
